review.why: This is a faithful translation of the system rather than an inappropriate copy of Home. The production screen preserves the mineral surface, operational typography, 16px outer gutters, compact 12px source handoff and restrained selection accents. Its ordinary records remain flat instead of becoming a generic card dashboard. Money is prominent without overwhelming the next required action, and payment conditions remain visible. Actual media is contained rather than substituted or dramatized. All four To do records are readable, and the labeled views and navigation remain exposed. The concrete remaining issue is the car row’s missing action/status separation; the different layout, smaller media and absence of Home’s graphite/cobalt opportunity assembly are appropriate to Activity.
review.verdict: Frame Shift was faithfully translated and the real Activity workflow remains visibly exposed, but the car row needs an explicit action and literal waiting status before release sign-off.
